Sub:- Compliance Audit of exempted establishments.
Sir,

Please refer to Head Office letter of even number dt. 18/10/10 and reminders dt.
24/12/10 & 18/01/11 on the above subject

[2 Despite specific directions and reminders, the desired report in Annexure-l! of the
compliance audit conducted till 31/03/10 from the above mentioned regions has not
been received till date. The matter has been viewed very seriously and therefore, it is
requested that the said report compiled in respect of all the offices of your region be
submitted within 3 days positively.

3: As directed vide our letter of even number dt. 18/01/11, duly completed
compliance audit reports till 31/03/10 of all cases for grant of exemption forwarded to
Head Office also be submitted immediately. As the latest compliance audit report is
required by the Ministry of Labour for considering the request for exemption, it should
be ensured that all the columns of the report are duly filled up by the Inspecting Squad
Further, enclosures like balance sheet of the trust, establishment, list of contractors and
their compliance status etc. should also be invariably submitted alongwith specific
recommendations/comments of the RPFC-I.

4. It is reiterated that wherever violations of conditions of exemption have been
noticed during the compliance audit, necessary action as prescribed under the Act &
Scheme should be initiated immediately and an action taken report should also be
submitted alongwith the compliance audit report in all such cases.
